data.content: {"type":"doc","content":[{"type":"image-text-2","attrs":{"id":"imageText_TSrkY","src":"https://bbx-pic.gtimg.com/bbx/pictures/2026/458_20260803172846_293699.png","caption":"品牌状态形态","naturalWidth":751,"naturalHeight":1624,"imgAlign":"right"},"content":[{"type":"heading","attrs":{"level":2},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"产品介绍"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"comment","attrs":{"comment":null,"id":null}}],"text":"首次支持品牌定制合作表情状态，品牌可在状态面板自选表情图标，自定义品牌状态名；同时支持品牌多段TVC轮播展示，并对应设置多款状态，轮焕出新，打造多元立体品牌形象，吸引用户跟设状态，点击互动。"}]},{"type":"heading","attrs":{"level":2},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"售卖方式"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"comment","attrs":{"comment":null,"id":null}}],"text":"支持合约售卖。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"comment","attrs":{"comment":null,"id":null}}],"text":"如有投放意向，可以联系你的行业 / 渠道运营经理，或拨打我们的销售热线获取帮助。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"comment","attrs":{"comment":null,"id":null}}],"text":"销售热线："},{"type":"telphone","attrs":{"id":"telphone_-w-Jc","telphone":4000617816},"marks":[{"type":"comment","attrs":{"comment":null,"id":null}}]}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"}}]}]}
